\begin{theorem}\label{finite}
Every finite topological space is compact.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}For each point choose one member of the cover containing it.\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}\label{closed}
Every closed subset of a compact space is compact.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}Adjoin the open complement to the cover and use compactness.\end{proof}
